line_en: Do not take away what our members built in this district.
Our supporters turn out at every election. Remember that when you write the next budget.
The towns run these services. Do not decide for us from Sapporo.
Give the towns the money and the say, and the mayors will carry it home for you.
Every new rule is a cost our members pass on or lay off.
Business can live with a lot, if it has time and a clear rule.
Our blocks were here before this plan and will be here after it.
Put residents in the room and you will find us easy to work with.
The sea feeds this coast. Do not trade it away.
Look after the harbors and the quota, and we will look after you.
Workers paid for the last reform. Not again.
Write the protections in plainly and our members will back you.
Farming families cannot absorb another shock.
Keep the price steady and the paddies working, and you have the villages.
It is our generation that inherits this.
Give young people a real stake and we will be loud for you.
Parents are stretched thin already.
Put families first in the detail and we will say so publicly.
Some things, once lost, are not rebuilt.
Respect what is old and we can talk about what is new.
